protocol_initial: First check corrected native FP64 against retained upstream strict continuation. Then independently converge four routes from atomic initial densities with scf.restart=off, fresh empty directories and no supplied restart. Use history8 from the outset, retaining the original RMM-DIISH weights and Pulay start. No runtime SCF control files. The stopped exploratory history50 trial is archived and is not counted as a completed cold-start result.

runtime_mixing_schedule.rule: After63 completed SCF steps, install the same mixing-only SCF control file. It is consumed at the following SCF boundary (around64). Continue each independent atomic-density cold start with fixed0.3 simple Hamiltonian mixing, without restarting. Criterion1e-12 and cap400 remain unchanged.

notes: The correction check reuses the historical near-converged restart only to isolate the arithmetic correction; it is separate from all four independent cold starts.
All four cold starts use scf.restart=off in fresh per-route directories. No density, Hamiltonian or mixing history is shared.

History8 and original initial mixing weights/Pulay start are common to all four atomic-density cold starts. A mixing-only SCF file switches each unconverged route aroundSCF64 to fixed0.3 simple Hamiltonian mixing. It contains no stopping-threshold or restart keyword; every printed criterion remains1e-12. The archived history50 trial was interrupted after93steps and is not a converged result.
SCF convergence checks band-energy change and mixing residual, not an absolute total-energy error bound. Printed 12-decimal diagnostics can round a valid internal dUele to 1e-12.
scf.fp32.enable=off now leaves inherited float-product rounding unchanged. Native FP64 selects accelerated grid/orbital/GEMM arithmetic; existing table storage remains float.
